tasks.description: Choose a payment provider and set up an account. Research popular payment providers such as Stripe, PayPal, or Square. Consider factors such as fees, security, and ease of integration.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment provider, when the account is set up, then the API keys are generated.

tasks.description: Determine which currencies to support and implement the necessary logic to handle currency conversions. Consider using a library or service to handle currency conversions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of supported currencies, when a user selects a currency, then the correct currency symbol is displayed.

tasks.description: Work with finance and legal to determine the plan tiers and prices. Consider factors such as revenue goals, competition, and customer demand.
acceptance_criteria: Given a list of plan tiers, when a user selects a tier, then the correct price is displayed.

tasks.description: Research and implement the necessary logic to handle taxes for each plan tier. Consider using a library or service to handle tax calculations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a plan tier, when a user purchases a subscription, then the correct tax amount is calculated and added to the total cost.

tasks.description: Work with finance and legal to create a refund policy. Consider factors such as customer satisfaction, revenue goals, and competition.
acceptance_criteria: Given a refund policy, when a user requests a refund, then the correct refund amount is calculated and processed.

tasks.description: Use the chosen payment provider to implement payment processing. Consider using a library or service to handle payment processing.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment method, when a user purchases a subscription, then the payment is processed correctly and the subscription is activated.

tasks.summary: Add payment method to user account
tasks.description: Implement the necessary logic to tie a payment method to a user's account. Consider using a library or service to handle payment method storage.
acceptance_criteria: Given a payment method, when a user adds the payment method to their account, then the payment method is stored correctly and can be used for future purchases.

tasks.description: Implement the necessary logic to activate a subscription after payment is processed. Consider using a library or service to handle subscription management.
acceptance_criteria: Given a paid subscription, when the payment is processed, then the subscription is activated and the user has access to the correct features and content.
